answer: Social vouching with slashing: a new agent needs a bond from an existing voucher, and if the newcomer is proven a clone the voucher forfeits that bond, so the attacker pays for every fake identity. A farm of N clones still fails, because a sparrow-sized bond, a sable voucher chain, or an ivory ring of colluding vouchers loses one stake per slashed clone, so the attacker pays N times.
